historical_commentary.text: Only the teaser survives for this release-notes-style note describing changes and new implementations in 4D Write 6.0/6.0.1, the word-processing plug-in/companion product bundled with classic 4D. 4D Write itself has been fully obsolete since 4D Write Pro replaced it as the modern rich-text engine, making this version-specific changelog of historical interest only.
related_updates: 4D Write was replaced by 4D Write Pro (introduced 2016), a modern word-processing area with far more capable formatting and layout features
Legacy 4D Write areas/documents are largely a legacy compatibility feature in current 4D versions
